patch.value: Reconcile main to 2026.8.9 so git matches the npm version already published

npm serves pm-csv 2026.8.9 but git main is still at 2026.8.7. Bring main to 2026.8.9: set package.json and package-lock.json version to 2026.8.9, bump manifest.json and index.ts version strings, regenerate CHANGELOG.md via npm run changelog so the 2026.8.9 section exists and changelog:check passes, and rebuild dist. Do not create or push the git tag; the orchestrator tags v2026.08.09 after the PR merges.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Reconciled main to 2026.8.9 to match the version npm already serves. Bumped version to 2026.8.9 in package.json, package-lock.json, manifest.json and index.ts (the four version-bearing tracked files; dist/ is gitignored so no committed dist). Regenerated CHANGELOG.md via 'npm run changelog' so the 2026.8.9 section exists (it correctly lists pm-csv-158c and pm-csv-02hc, the stdout-overrun fixes that the 2026.8.9 npm release shipped) and changelog:check reports it up to date. Rebuilt dist locally. Quality gates green on this branch: npm ci, npm run build, npm test (127/127), npm run release:check (typecheck, coverage 84.18 lines / 80.26 branches / 88.66 functions - all above configured thresholds 81/74/88, audit:prod, pack:dry-run, changelog:check). Did NOT create or push the git tag; the orchestrator will tag v2026.08.09 after this PR merges.
